title: Seoul shares sharply up late Tue. morning on tech rally, lower oil prices
caption:
South Korean stocks are seeing a major boost today as oil prices slide and tech giants like Samsung lead a market-wide rally. The surge follows growing hopes for stability in the Middle East, which has eased global inflation concerns.
